_doc: Starting style of the kit. The « style-de-montage » skill copies it to looks/<name>/look.json and changes only what the creator chose (on their own edited video, their brand, and A/B/C choice videos). Claude applies a look, it never reinvents one. Every value here was validated on real YouTube videos read at the teleprompter.

brand._doc: accent = the strong word and the diamonds ; background = full-screen visuals ; title_family = keyword font (a family of assets/fonts, or one added in fonts : [{"family": "MaPolice", "file": "MaPolice-Bold.ttf", "weight": 800}], the file copied to assets/fonts with its licence).

one_camera._why: One phone : every cut reframes the same camera (wide, tight, very tight), so a cut never shows as a jump. Film in 4K so the tight frames stay sharp.

two_cameras._why: Two phones : 4 front shots out of 6 (the front camera carries the video), the side camera stays wider. The hook always opens on the front camera. crop_x_min {"B": 780} keeps an object at the left edge of camera B out of the tight frame.

cut._why: A cut every 2 to 3 s, but the camera only changes every 4 to 7 s (it reframes on the same camera in between). Never more than 0.45 s of silence inside a sentence (0.75 s already drags), 0.28 s of breath kept after the last word so no word ending is eaten.

default.name: B
default._why: One shot pushes in slowly (100 to 108 %), the next pulls out (108 to 100 %).

accent.name: C
accent.use: now and then, on a strong word (number, reveal, promise), alternating with the dezoom D, never on every shot

dezoom.name: D
dezoom.kind: quick dezoom at the start of the shot
dezoom.use: every other accent (C, D, C, D...)

zoom._why_words: Spoken words that may receive an accent zoom, besides numbers and keywords (a regular expression, lowercase).

sound._why: A pop on each keyword, a whoosh on each visual, a light click on each cut. A sound effect never lasts more than 0.5 s under a calm sentence (a long riser or glitch sounds like a crackle). Files in assets/sfx (tools/make_sfx.py writes an original default set).

music._why: Dark minimal « suspense tech » electro under the whole video : a new track on each chapter card, never the same twice in a row. Tracks are not in the repo (licences) : tools/musique.py downloads free ones and fills this palette, with their credit line for the description.

intro._why_under: 14 LU under the voice in the intro (11 was too loud).

body.new_track: on every chapter card, after a 1.5 s fade out (a 1 s hard cut was too abrupt), back with hook-impact-2.wav
body.always: music under the whole video : a track shorter than its chapter loops (3 s crossfade) up to the next card
body._why_under: After the intro the music sits lower (23.6 LU under the voice) : 18 then 20.5 were still judged too loud.

music.rules: no impact after the closing reverse cymbal ; never the same track twice in a row ; music fades out on the conclusion, none under the call to action

outro.rule: on the conclusion the music fades out over 2 s, then no music under the call to action

music.avoid: no high-pitched lead over the voice : listen to a new track's 800 Hz - 3 kHz band before using it, and set end_before if a lead comes in

keywords._why: Keywords yes, the whole sentence never. Only the speaker's own words, only the important ones, each landing as it is said.
keywords.text: own spoken words only (never invented text), 1 to 4 short words, each word landing on its spoken time ; only the important ones (number, price, contrast, key notion) ; never over a full-screen visual
keywords.font: title_family 900, uppercase, 116 px, tracking -0.03em, centred at 83.5 % of the height (on the chest)
keywords.colors: white with a faint metal fall-off, strong word in the accent colour with a glow
keywords.motion: each word : blur 14 px -> 0, y 12 -> 0, scale 1.06 -> 1 in 170 ms ; dark veil on the lower 52 % while shown ; exit 160 ms scale 0.96
